CLIENTSSL_DATA
Description
An “
iRule event
triggered after ingress SSL
plaintext data has been collected from the clientssl connection.
Note “commands” which may suspend iRule processing
(
after
,
persist
and
session
) should not be used in this event prior to
10.1.0 where CR101506/ID204163 was fixed.
Examples
when
CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE
{
# Trigger collection of the decrypted payload once the SSL handshake has been completed successfully
SSL
::
collect
}
when
CLIENTSSL_DATA
{
# Do something with the decrypted data
set
payload
[
SSL
::
payload
]
# Release the payload
SSL
::
release
}
